card: Enables the `-Wunused-const-variable` compiler warning flag in CMake and changes header-defined constants in `logging.h`, `mempool_estimator.h`, and embedded subtrees to `inline constexpr`. Without `inline`, header constants have internal linkage and trigger compiler errors in translation units where they are not referenced. The change is split out from an effort to enable `-Wunused` (#36167) and depends on subtree updates #36278 and #36298.
changed_since_previous: Formalized dependencies on internal subtree update pull requests #36278 and #36298 instead of external upstream repository PRs.
evidence: PR description quotes build failure: `src/logging.h:66:24: error: 'BCLog::RATELIMIT_MAX_BYTES' defined but not used [-Werror=unused-const-variable=]`
problem: Header-declared `const` and `constexpr` variables default to internal linkage, triggering `-Wunused-const-variable` warnings or errors whenever a translation unit includes the header without referencing every declared constant.

risk.why: Mistakes would cause compile-time failures rather than runtime defects.

scope_notes: Contains temporary `[nomerge]` commits directly modifying vendored subtree files in `src/crc32c` and `src/minisketch`, pending the merge of in-repo subtree update PRs #36278 and #36298.
summary: Enables the `-Wunused-const-variable` compiler warning flag in CMake. To prevent compilation errors across translation units, header-declared `constexpr` constants in `logging.h`, `mempool_estimator.h`, and embedded subtrees are marked `inline constexpr`.
